about.en: ORBIO is the token of Orbio.so, a service that resells large-language-model inference credits at a discount; half of the project's trading fees are converted into OpenRouter inference credits paid to holders. It is an ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain at 0xaa07a0e9209e16ac99708c3ec70159c6ef3128a3, and is unrelated to the Solana token Pikamoon, which some listings also show as ORBIO.
